    Map systems and their R_ω-structures #

    A map system on a set X is a countable family of partial maps fₑ : Dₑ → X. A linear map φ on k^(X) commutes with it if φ(eᵢ) ∈ k^(Dₑ) and φ(e_{fₑ i}) = (fₑ)_* φ(eᵢ) for i ∈ Dₑ. The R_ω-structure k^(X) ⊕ k^(X) with the two summands, the diagonal and the graphs of the (fₑ)_* has as endomorphisms exactly the φ ⊕ φ with φ commuting (Rigid.isRigidR_of_isRigidSys). This is the linear form of the relations of Shelah (1974), Theorem 2.1.
